title: Require same-run RETURN+DONE before dependency activation
problem: Dependency-gated claims can activate from RETURN directory existence before the qualifying dependency run reaches same-run DONE. Live evidence: O-SURFACE-CONTROL_PLAN-LOCAL-INTEGRATE-V1 claimed at 2026-09-17T09:54:43-03:00 and cited O-SWARM-PAGE-THREAD-BRIDGE-V1 as activation evidence, while the Page Thread recovery RETURN explicitly said readiness must wait for same-run DONE and that exact run did not finish DONE until 2026-09-17T09:55:30-03:00.
mission: Harden dynamic readiness so a dependency satisfies ALL_DEPENDENCIES_HAVE_RETURN only when one exact qualifying run_id has both its terminal RETURN and matching DONE, with fail-closed treatment for RETURN-only, mixed-run, stale-recovery, or ambiguous multi-return evidence. Add a regression canary for the observed 09:54:43 versus 09:55:30 ordering and emit machine-auditable readiness receipts naming the qualifying run_id for every dependency.
acceptance: Dynamic readiness requires one exact run_id to have both terminal RETURN and DONE before a dependent claim is eligible.
Concurrent or stale recovery RETURNs lacking same-run DONE cannot satisfy dependency readiness.
A canary reproduces the 09:54:43 dependent claim versus 09:55:30 dependency DONE ordering and rejects the claim until DONE exists.
Readiness receipts identify the qualifying run_id for every dependency and fail closed on ambiguous or mixed-run evidence.

live_falsification.dependency_return_boundary: RETURN alone is insufficient for dynamic readiness; the exact same run must be closed DONE.
live_falsification.observed_result: The dependent claim existed 47 seconds before the cited dependency had the exact same-run RETURN+DONE lifecycle pair required by its own return boundary.

unblock_value.reason: Dependency activation is a universal gate for successor work; a false-positive readiness decision can start downstream writers before prerequisites are terminal.

information_gain.reason: The defect is grounded in a durable live ordering mismatch rather than a hypothetical race.

regression_prevention.reason: A same-run qualification rule plus canary prevents RETURN-only or mixed-run evidence from unlocking future dependent waves.

human_friction_reduction.reason: Fail-closed machine-auditable readiness receipts reduce manual reconciliation of ambiguous recovery evidence.

candidate_read_scope: scripts and tests implementing dynamic-readiness semantics
falsification: A dependent opportunity becomes eligible while every RETURN for one dependency lacks matching same-run DONE.
A RETURN from run A plus DONE from run B is accepted as one qualifying dependency lifecycle.
Ambiguous concurrent recovery returns are accepted without naming an exact qualifying run_id.
The regression fixture permits the 09:54:43 dependent claim before the 09:55:30 dependency DONE.
The fix edits source queue statuses or promotes Current, Human Accepted, Served, or production /w authority.
dedup_note: This is distinct from pdf-2f30cbb2722d860a60cd623c75535495. That candidate serializes concurrent stale-recovery authority. This candidate hardens downstream dependency qualification even when multiple recovery artifacts already exist, requiring exact same-run terminal evidence before readiness can unlock a successor.
